mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate profitability and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months where FEDFUNDS has been above 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls and decline in the unemployment rate signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint labor market strength.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS (up) and UNRATE (down) fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns with a Rank IC < 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 thousand units and real personal consumption expenditures exceed 700,000 million dollars, the economy enters a late-cycle expansion phase where equity valuations become stretched, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months meeting both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000 thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where INDPRO increased by at least 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to prolonged monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months where CPIAUCSL y/y growth exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (unemployment rate below 3.5% and payroll growth exceeding 100,000 jobs), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns as the Federal Reserve maintains high interest rates to curb inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of months meeting UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 150000 thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index falls below 100.0 (base 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.0.
